hooks.text: 右手托着仓鼠外形的歼灭武器瞄准敌人，击杀掉落种子并通过随机选项获得技能。
hooks.excerpt: Hold MOCHI-O in your right hand, aim at the enemy, and attack. Enemies you defeat will drop seeds. As you accumulate experience gained from picking up the seeds, you will gain skills from random choices.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战斗收入用于强化和解锁武器，喂给 MOCHI-O 种子还能提高信赖等级与属性。
hooks.excerpt: Spend the money you earn in battle to strengthen MOCHI-O. You can also unlock weapons, which will give you an advantage in battle. Giving seeds to MOCHI-O will increase its trust level and strengthen its status.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: “可爱仓鼠”其实是国土防卫歼灭武器，饲养员关系与温馨对白包裹末日战争。
hooks.excerpt: A cute hamster......but a handy annihilation weapon for homeland defense. The player's mission is to raise MOCHI-O as a keeper and protect his country from foreign enemies. The heartwarming dialogue between the characters is also a highlight of the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 几百颗瓜子需要逐粒点击，操作过于费力

opinions.text: 1至2小时游玩中几乎没有疲软感，令人不舍离开

excerpts.excerpt: 1-2小时内的游玩中更是爱不释手不舍得离开，可以说基本没有疲软的地方
